name: benchmark-vidore-v3-industrial
description: Benchmark measuring model performance on industrial visual inspection and recognition tasks drawn from the VIDORE v3 industrial subset. It evaluates models on object-level recognition and anomaly/defect detection in industrial imagery, under realistic variations in viewpoint and lighting. Intended to compare detection/classification and anomaly-detection approaches for industrial vision systems.
reputation: Niche industrial-vision benchmark with moderate adoption among researchers working on industrial inspection and anomaly detection.
